baseline.historical_status: J7 near-degenerate global case remains FAIL; this preflight does not edit or reinterpret its result

input.source_sha_convention: SHA-256 over Git-canonical UTF-8 LF source bytes; binary input uses raw bytes

hypothesis: A smooth vertical bubble displacement of only the three strictly interior logical nodes can vary element Jacobians while leaving every exterior node coordinate, support node, load node, and physical boundary coordinate unchanged.

geometry.source: archived J7 near-degenerate HEX8 state; coordinates and connectivity are read directly from the immutable J8 input NPZ
geometry.mesh: 4 x 2 x 2 HEX8 cells, 45 nodes, 16 elements
geometry.interior_nodes: the three nodes at x in {5,10,15} m, y=0.5 m, z=0.02 m
geometry.transformation: z_i(alpha) = z_i(0) + alpha * 0.04 m * sin(pi*x_i/20 m) for the three strictly interior nodes; all other nodes are unchanged
geometry.bounding_box_note: The archived z bounding-box extent is 0.046 m because the outer face is also skewed; 0.04 m is the top-to-bottom coordinate difference at fixed x,y.

operations: modify candidate interior coordinates in memory
evaluate all HEX8 Gauss Jacobian determinants
verify exterior node coordinates are bitwise unchanged

criteria.gauss_determinants: all finite and strictly positive at all eight Gauss points of every element
criteria.exterior_geometry: every non-interior node coordinate is bitwise identical to the archived J7 geometry
criteria.boundary_envelope: the physical coordinate bounding box is unchanged

scope.decision: If a candidate fails, reduce the candidate alpha set and freeze a revised contract before any FEM execution.

resources.semantics: local geometry-only script; no monitored FEM attempt is reserved
